options.name: Sewer replacement from the house to the trap
options.summary:
This is to replace the sewer main from the house to the trap. The current piping is cast iron and the new piping would be shd 35 pvc piping. The technician will be replacing about 40’ of piping and the depth is 8’ deep. The technician would remove the ground covering plants in the mulched in area.  

The technician will first mark the area to be dug and the place the PA1 call for safe digging. The technician would then dig down exposing the piping and would make a clean cut to tie onto and then remove the old selections of cast iron piping. The technician would the place stone on the bottom of the trench and install the piping.  The technician would install a new trap at the house and then install a clean out where the current trap is. The technician would then test for proper pitch and test the sewer. The technician will also have a third party inspection completed and after passing would begin by placing stone on the top side of the pipe. The technician would then begin to back fill the trench using the soil that was removed. The technician will tamp the ground as filling to help prevent any settling and will leave the ground at a rough finish. 

The homeowner would be responsible for any landscaping.

options.name: Jetting of sewer main
options.summary: This is to use a netter to clean the main sewer.  With there being cast iron from the trap to the house and with that cast iron having multiple bellies and channel rot this is not ideal to perform and may cause more issues.

jobs.writeUp: Upon arrival the technician used a sewer camera to inspect the main sewer after having multiple backups this month. The technician found that the sewer line from the house to the trap is cast iron and has channel rot and bellies in the line. The sewer main going to the street is SRD except for a small section and that section is cast iron and appears to need a jetting. The technician provided solutions to use a jetter on the street side of the trap and to replace the sewer main from the house to the trap.

jobs.writeUp: Upon arrival the technician discussed the previous opening with the homeowner and then began by using a sewer camera to inspect the sewer main.  The technician first traveled down toward the street and and was unable to make it past the trap completely.  The technician only traveled at best 5’ toward the street.  The technician then traveled toward the house and found a heavy amount of sludge almost at the house.  The technician also found that the sewer trap in the front yard is cast iron while the remainder of the piping is PVC.  The technician then provided solutions to the homeowner.
